purpose: Deterministic, repo-native Platform vNext regression baseline for the accepted G1-G7 platform invariants (Issue #53). Every group references existing authoritative pytest modules; no test logic is duplicated here. The canonical entrypoint runs each group with `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`, reports the failing group, and exits non-zero if any required group fails.

groups.purpose: G1 workspace / Simulation Scope foundation: structural identity/path, container-only vs executable-capable, fail-closed hierarchy/reference validation.
G2 provenance v2: immutable RunContextV2, simulation origin/status, envelope/namespace identity.
G3 observation/event/alarm: domain truth vs immutable facts/projections, alarm event immutability, canonical provenance/time/identity fail-closed.
G4 composition/coordinator: containment vs connectivity graph, coordinator as composition service, deterministic participant/commit ordering, exact-window semantics.
G5 TIPA ASSY federation: six isolated executable sub-line scopes mapped correctly, no demo policy promoted, natural-boundary semantics.
G6 shared hierarchy UI: path-qualified context authority, workspace/container vs executable distinction, ASSY + continuous hierarchy truthfulness.

G7 hierarchical run control: one mutable active attempt per workspace, independent TIPA/continuous active runs, historical/superseded fail-closed, fresh attempt state, path-qualified continuous/PROCESS participant.
Continuous dashboard + OPS interaction/overview + S04B gating API compatibility (legacy compatibility surfaces).

Complete ASSY regression oracle: SSO2 feed/queue ordering, PRE-ASSY token, AP04 RSO2 JOIN/genealogy, AP06 retest-in-place, AP08 reinspect, AP11 final QC, failed_final, LINE_OUT GOOD/REJECT, quality/checklist/measurement evidence, deterministic timestamps, six sub-lines, no FINISHED conveyor fabrication.
Continuous-process + compressor baseline: process dynamics, closed loop, PID, balance, engine/controller boundary, compressor train/states/operating states.
G8 cross-gate invariants (workspace/structural/run-control/UI-hierarchy alignment) not directly covered by individual gate suites.
Full repository suite: every pytest module under tests/.
